items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited. Severity unknown; Friday update expected. Comes after Davante Adams IR.
items.why: Left practice early; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Availability for Week 7 vs LV uncertain; monitor Friday. With Adams already out, any miss crushes Rams pass game.
items.opportunity: If out or limited, residual targets to remaining WRs/TEs but volume drop overall.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP for second straight day (hamstring).
items.implication: Likely OUT or high risk for Week 7 vs SEA; elevates other KC WRs.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and others see expanded routes/targets if out.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley expected to return to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs Cowboys.
items.why: Sources: practice return and expected to play.
items.implication: Reclaims lead back role; reverse prior handcuff beneficiaries. Efficient prior games + DAL matchup.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/red-zone share vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS uncertainty; potential landing spot upgrade or Colts commit.
items.opportunity: Monitor for role/change of scenery boost.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall back to practice (quad).
items.implication: Trending toward Week 7 availability vs MIA; monitor full/limited.
items.opportunity: Restores lead back carries/routes if cleared.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list; significant move. Eligible for Week 7.
items.why: Full practice progress; roster move completed.
items.implication: Could share or limit Kenneth Walker III (or SEA lead back) snaps/carries immediately or soon; handcuff value flips.
items.opportunity: Charbonnet goal-line/early-down share potential; monitor exact role.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings/lifting/medical (non-football). MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers; OL mess contributes. Discussed long-term outlook on ROS Top-150.
items.implication: Positive for near-term return and ROS RB value despite layoff; backups not seizing role.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries upon full clearance; handcuffs weak.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (ankle).
items.why: On field for practice start after prior absences.
items.implication: Positive step for Week 7 availability; limited designation likely.
items.opportunity: If plays, full offense unlocks; else Huntley.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson IR delay means Rams' answer to Davante Adams absence is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson not ready off IR; Adams out long-term.
items.implication: Massive target spike/ROS WR1 lock if healthy; calf news now conflicts.
items.conflict: New calf injury threatens the projection.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role.
items.implication: Strong WR start; volume vs soft Bears.

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume.
items.implication: WR1/2 start with Saquon back but still high usage.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18). Workload question after long layoff.
items.implication: Fade or cautious start; Levitan more positive on backups.
items.conflict: Levitan notes poor backup EPA and facility access as positive.

items.text: Loves Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9). Big workloads in friendly matchups.
Thorman Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB@CAR; high volume GB/DET, LAR/LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ, others. Free article notes.
items.implication: Prioritize players in high-volume games for DFS/season-long ceiling.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/carries in TB/CAR, Packers-Lions, Rams-Raiders.
